generation_notes: Rebuilt as exactly 4 distinct PK-only seeds around conservative IEC 60870-5-104 APCI framing, because review feedback explicitly requested clean 0x68 APDUs instead of mixed 101/104 hybrids. Supplied sources directly ground Type Identification values, APCI/U-format categories, common command qualifier semantics, and recommended seed operations. Concrete APCI byte layouts and I-format control-field patterns are completed conservatively from widely recognized IEC 60870-5-104 practice only where the supplied excerpts are silent. All 0x68 length octets match the bytes that follow. Diversity was improved across pure U-format control, stateful handshake plus system command, control command, and monitoring/report paths. Exact previously removed payloads and malformed historical frames were not reused.

sequences.title: STARTDT handshake followed by General Interrogation

U-format frames keep fixed 4-byte control payload with matching length 0x04

sequences.issue_safety_notes: Safe stateful seed; structurally valid handshake and request only, avoiding malformed control combinations and historical collisions.
